messages:
alex: Kicking off RC creation for release-2026-03-21. There's a late DB migration that needs to run during quiet window. I want to request an exemption to DB freeze for just the migration. CC @maya @suresh

maya: What's the migration? Short description pls.

suresh: It's an index add to users.email to speed joins. Online/pt-rot migration, ~3m runway. No backfill.

alex: Plan: run migration on staging, run smoke, then promote. If migration fails revert schema via rollback script. migration command:
```
./tools/db-migrate run --version add-email-index
```

deploy-bot: CI: build 1842 succeeded. Artifacts pinned to sha:abc123. Promotion window open 21:00-23:00 UTC.

lisa: I'm on sheriff tonight, ok from SRE side if we keep user traffic <5% for canary. Add KV warm and cache flush plan.

maya: +1 from product if release notes include the migration note. Link to release doc: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-db-email-index

suresh: I'll run a dry-run on staging at 19:00 UTC and post logs.

alex: Rollback criteria: 1) >=5% error rate 2) latency p99 > 2x baseline 3) migration error or table lock detected. If triggered we abort and run rollback script:
```
./tools/db-migrate revert --version add-email-index
```

qa-sheriff: QA will run smoke post-migration: sample prompts for embed service, run `healthcheck.sh`. Tag me when staging dry-run done.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled at 21:30 UTC to prod shard us-west-2 on 3 instances. Command: `/promote --artifact abc123 --env prod --shard us-west-2 --batch 3`

maya: Approved. @alex make sure release notes have fallback instructions. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all. staging dry-run logs: https://logs.internal/1788888123/dryrun . I'll ping when it's green.
